purpose: ZX Spectrum PLUS3DOS header and declared-payload observation for two retained P3F profiles. The declared payload and any physical tail are preserved without assuming an executable interpreter image.
remaining_requirements: meaning of the PLUS3DOS header load field and file type for these P3F profiles
loader command and CP/M or +3DOS context
machine-code entry and bounded interpreter image
qualified analyzer configuration and cross-tool disagreement record
non_claim: A valid PLUS3DOS header and declared payload do not establish an interpreter payload, executable entry, loader behavior, source recovery, or ZX runtime behavior.
